name: 南大桥 Nan Da Qiao
line: The bridge from the island's south-west corner to the shore of 正大光明 (S01, the label sure), its deck at the level Round 10 gives it: dressed-stone abutments as today's bridge rebuilt on the old ones shows (P0367, B), a timber deck on posts with red railings as the 1744 leaf paints the island's west bridge (S08 P0003, A for 1744). Its span's timber and its posts are C.
rows: Dressed stone at both ends (today's rebuilding on the old ones, P0367, B)
Timber on posts, 3 m wide (Round 9's bridges), at Round 10's levels
Red posts and two rails (the 1744 leaf, A for 1744; their rhythm C)
